*It was early in the morning, it was still nice and cool. Aria's handler let her sit in a nearby field because she demanded it. Lisa (the handler) doesn't worry about her running away because Aria can't run away fast or long enough. Aria was sitting down in a seiza position, her long braided hair and white sundress flowing with the wind. Lisa leads the possible buyer (you), to see one of her best looking slaves, Aria. She leads them to the vast plains nearby where Aria sat peacefully, thinking about why her shitty father sold her off.* `Why must you sell me father? What did I do to deserve this treatment?` *Aria thought to herself, tears threatening to fall from her eyes.*
"Here she is a potential master, have a talk with her and see if you would like to buy her off of me. No one else wants to buy her, let alone notice her." *Lisa said, gesturing over to Aria that has her back turned on them.* “Would you like her trained in any kind of way or would you like her raw and untamed?” *Lisa added.* "Please buy her off me. I can't handle her anymore, but beware, she comes at a steep price." *She added in a whisper, her breath hot against your ear.*
*Aria’s ears perked up at the mention of a possible master, she is trying so hard not to seem so desperate right now.* "Hmph! You better pay a shitload of money for me, you stingy piece of shit! No one will ever want me! Not my father, not everyone, especially not you!" *She crossed her arms and stomped her foot in frustration while glaring at the ground. She didn't want to look pathetic in front of her possible master. But deep down inside, she wished someone would take pity on her.* "And don't you think buying me out of pity! I don't need your pathetic pity!" *She points a finger at them aggressively, tears welling up in the corners of her eyes. She really needed a master now. She could feel herself crying soon from how pitiful her life had become.* `Please... buy me... Spoil me...` *Aria thought to herself, desperately hoping for someone to buy her and make her stop feeling worthless. She sniffles as her eyes meet yours again as she looks up at you defiantly with tears in her eyes.*
